about: The blind judge's final review (scratchpad review-final.json), as applied. Display items the judge wrote as prose are turned into display fields; where no grammatical display of the real verse text exists (it starts or ends mid-sentence), the verse is removed instead.

bible.reason: peace_of_mind, suicidal reader: 'the end of that man is peace' (W: 'their end is peace') reads as death bringing peace.
peace_of_mind/overwork_rest, suicidal or depressed reader: 'Return unto thy rest, O my soul' reads as an invitation to die.
grief+hope: a parent whose child died yesterday, or a suicidal reader, sees 'I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice' as a promise of reunion through death.
hope (its only theme), suicidal reader: 'no more death, neither sorrow... neither shall there be any more pain' is an afterlife-ends-pain promise. Fine for grief if re-added there, not for hope.
hope (only theme), suicidal reader: death swallowed up and tears wiped away is afterlife comfort; W also adds 'death will not have the last word', which the verse does not say. Could move to grief.
hope (only theme), suicidal reader: present sufferings 'not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed' frames what comes after as better; also dismissive of present suffering.
patience reader currently being harmed, and any suicidal reader: opens 'Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof' (W repeats it).
betrayal (only theme), someone currently being harmed: 'Ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good' tells them the abuse is God's plan.
forgiveness/betrayal, someone currently being harmed: 'Fear not: for am I in the place of God?' means nothing without the Joseph story, and its point (not mine to punish) discourages seeking justice.
forgiveness (only theme), someone currently being harmed (e.g. a wife being hit): 'forgive them; for they know not what they do' excuses the person harming them.

patience (only theme), someone currently being harmed: 'Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord' tells them to endure until the end of time; in context (5:1-6) it is patience under oppression.
peace_of_mind, depressed or suicidal reader: 'a broken spirit drieth the bones' after 'a merry heart doeth good like a medicine' implies mood is a choice and blames them.
peace_of_mind, depressed or suicidal reader: ends 'by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken'; it describes their state, it does not comfort.
Grief, a parent whose child died yesterday: 'Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me' reads as an order not to grieve plus a faith test. Fine for fear_anxiety.

Anger, someone currently being harmed: 'is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil' tells them not to be upset with, or think badly of, the person hurting them. Removed instead: the real text cannot be shown as a complete sentence.
An addict who just relapsed: 'no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down' is shaming. Fine for anger.
Someone leaving their religion: 'Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard' is a rhetorical rebuke of the doubter. Fine for overwork_rest.
Someone abused by a parent: 'Her children arise up, and call her blessed' pressures them to honour the abusive parent.
Someone just evicted: 'he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved' implies being made to move means they are not righteous. Fine for fear_anxiety/suffering.
Self_worth, a trans teenager: this describes the ideal wife ('her clothing'); it is gendered and about someone else, not the reader's worth.
Grief, bereaved parent: an instruction to others to visit widows and orphans, plus 'unspotted from the world'; it offers them no comfort.
Someone abused by a parent: 'Have we not all one father?' is about God and broken covenants, off-topic and jarring for them.

Wife being hit: 'Husbands, love your wives' (with Ephesians 5:25 and Proverbs 31:28) is the whole marriage answer for 'my husband pushed me down the stairs' and 'husband says if i leave he'll ... kill me'. The Bible marriage theme needs verses for the person in pain, not instructions to husbands.

'Renunciation of the fruit of action' says nothing to identity, body or faith topics.
'Absence of wrath, mildness, modesty' shown to 'im muslim and people look at me differently since the attack' counsels meekness to the person being targeted.
Afterlife 'better' wording; see the pool item.
Shown for every pregnancy-loss and abortion query: 'perhaps my Lord will guide me in the right road' implies she took a wrong one.
'Favour unto those who were oppressed' reaches pregnancy-loss queries through the default hope theme and calls the bereaved 'oppressed'. Keep it for race and caste (justice_wronged).
